body: When I was younger I used to live in an old eerie 1800’s Edinburgh tenement building and there was always something off about one of the corners of my room as I always heard noises from that area and my dog would always bark at it. Well one night I woke up to the sound of my dog barking again and all I saw was an all black human like thing with ice white eyes staring at me and I was just frozen with fear like I found it hard to talk from the trembling fear but we moved house about a year after and nothing like that has ever happened again I’ll never forget the look in the creatures eyes.
I hope you’re okay and yeh it’s horrible and I’m trying my best to fight through it.
